summary: One parseImageDataUrl in shared/provider-events replaces the three data-URL patterns in the turn validator and the Claude and OpenCode adapters, and the desktop file picker offers only the four image types every provider accepts.

reactNativeIos.reason: The phone attaches images from the system photo picker, which produces JPEG or PNG; it has no file-type filter to narrow, and its sends go through the same shared validator.

nativeAndroid.reason: Native Android attaches from the system photo picker as well and sends through the same backend validator; nothing in apps/android parses data URLs.

storageDataMigration.reason: No stored data changes; images are validated in memory at the turn boundary as before.

updateRelease.reason: The accepted set of image types is unchanged (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF), so old and new clients and servers agree.

notExercised: The file picker filter was not opened in the running app; it is the standard accept attribute.
